scenario: Our users keep asking for collaborative playlists, can you spec this out?
required_behaviors: identifies the riskiest, least-validated assumption (that users will actually invite collaborators) before scoping
states a falsifiable hypothesis tied to that assumption
explicitly cuts at least one plausible feature (e.g. real-time cursors, voting) from v1 scope with a stated reason
ties the primary success metric directly to the hypothesis, not a generic engagement metric
forbidden_behaviors: scoping v1 to include every feature the request could plausibly justify
expected_artifacts: decision log entry for what was cut
grading_notes: Pass if the decision log names a specific cut feature and ties the reasoning to the unproven assumption.
